description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve a list of function names from a database
description_zh: 分页查询，获取数据库的函数名称列表
kebab_example: aliyun datalake list-function-names --catalog-id 1344371 --database-name database_test --function-name-pattern .0 --next-page-token example-string --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFunctionNames

parameters.description_en: The ID of the data catalog.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_id

parameters.description_en: The regular expression that the function names must match.
parameters.description_zh: 函数名匹配的正则表达式。
parameters.help_en: The regular expression that the function names must match
parameters.help_zh: 函数名匹配的正则表达式
parameters.name: function_name_pattern

parameters.description_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. It is returned in the response. To retrieve the first page, pass an empty string ('') or leave this parameter empty.
parameters.description_zh: 翻页token，从返回结果返回，无则传空字符串或''。
parameters.help_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. It is returned in the response. To retrieve the first page, pass an empty string ('') or leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh: 翻页token，从返回结果返回，无则传空字符串或''
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 1000.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 1000
parameters.name: page_size
